title: viburnum hallii
intro: Viburnum hallii, commonly known as Korean spice viburnum, is a species of flowering plant in the family Adoxaceae. It is known for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health due to its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Viburnum hallii include anti-anxiety and anti-depressive effects, attributed to the presence of bioactive constituents such as lignans, flavonoids, and phenolic acids. The bioactive constituents of Viburnum hallii include isoflavones, phenolic acids, and flavonoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
